title: Revenue job fails after upstream payments schema change
issue: Since Sep 20 the upstream payments export sends `amount_cents` (integer cents) instead of `amount` (dollars), and currency codes can now arrive in any letter case. The revenue job has been failing since. Revenue must stay in major currency units (e.g. dollars), rounded to 2 decimals, grouped by upper-case ISO currency code, with `payments` as the payment count.
